notes:
High-level: QueryHaven builds a multi-tenant KB product for SMB customers (customer-facing docs + internal playbooks). Aim: replace slow keyword search + boost answer accuracy with RAG + reranker.

POC scope: Hosted API only (no VPC) — initial ask is proof of latency & unit economics at moderate index scale (target 1.5-2.5M documents) and high sustained QPS (target 120-180 qps). Core success criteria: p95 end-to-end query latency < 150ms for reranked top-K (K=10), embedding+FAISS-style ANN recall > 92% on in-house eval set, and average cost per user query <$0.004.

Model preferences: open LLM base for embeddings (quantized Ada-like / miniLM equivalent), separate lightweight cross-encoder reranker (preferably quantized CPU fallback). Want to test Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching + cache TTL to hit p95 SLO. They asked about automatic KV/prefix caching for conversational flows.

Security & compliance: EU data residency is a requirement for EU customer subset; SSO (SAML) for admin console; audit logs + KMS integration. Legal flagged DPA + subprocessing list as blocking for final contract.

Notes from call: "If we can scale to 150 QPS and keep cost to single-digit cents per 1k queries, this replaces our current infra spend." — Head of ML (Nina).

Technical concerns: reranker CPU cost at high QPS; embedding index refresh cadence for incremental docs; warm-up latency after autoscale events. Requested explicit cost model for combinations: hosted small model embedding + cross-encoder rerank vs larger embedding + light rerank.

Next steps in detail:
- SE (Diego) to run full POC perf run: 2M doc index, 150 QPS sustained for 48h, measure p50/p95/p99 and token-level cost.
- Provide sample pricing scenarios (link to drive deck) and Optimize recommendations for quantization + batching.
- Legal to circulate DPA; engineering to confirm EU region availability for hosted API.

POC milestones (KPI):
- Week 1: ingest pipeline + 200k open/public docs, baseline QPS 50, measure latency.
- Week 2: scale to 2M docs, ramp to 150 QPS, enable reranker, measure cost/query and QA metrics.

Risk: procurement timeline (monthly procurement window), possible need to upgrade to Dedicated if audit/residency cannot be satisfied in hosted EU region.

Short-term ask: quick answers on EU data residency guarantees and sample cost calc for 150 QPS with reranker on hosted_api.

CRM shorthand/next actions: POC kickoff 2026-03-15 (tentative). AE to follow up with pricing and regional SLA note.
